老司机.definition: 老司机 lǎo sī jī, literally translating to "Old Driver" in English, is a slang term popular in Chinese [internet culture]. It refers to someone who is experienced or [knowledgeable], [particularly] in a context that is not typically found in books or formal education. The term is often used humorously and can have varying connotations depending on the context.
老司机.example: Ever been to [a party] where one guy knows [exactly] when to switch the songs for [maximum] hype? Yeah, that's the 老司机 of the DJ world.
